titulo: The folder is the context: README, AGENTS.md and Markdown
lead: When everything sits in a single folder, the AI reads material that has nothing to do with your request and you don't know where each sentence came from. One folder per subject, with one file for people and another for the agent, fixes this before the first request.
objetivo: set up the projetos/config tree and the project folder with entradas, saídas, README.md and AGENTS.md in Markdown.
hero_alt: Open steel filing cabinet with labeled hanging folders and a notebook in the background.

aprende.t: One folder per subject, and config for what applies to all of them
README for people, AGENTS.md for the agent
Edit with Notepad and check with type

secoes.sub: Each drawer holds one subject. Click each part.

nos.detalhe: Gathers independent jobs. Each folder inside it is one context: the material for a single subject. When you open the agent in a folder, it works from there.
It sits inside projetos, but outside each project. It keeps what always applies, like "I prefer short reports, with the open items at the end." Write it once, use it everywhere.
Entradas is what the AI reads; saídas is what it produces, for you to review. Kept apart, you can check one against the other. Don't mix in material from another client or another class here.
The agent looks for AGENTS.md on its own when it starts. It reads the rest when you point to it: the AI doesn't open every file in the folder by itself.

secoes.legenda: Short names, no spaces and no accents: meu-primeiro-agente, entradas, saidas.

rolagem_fim.texto: A separate folder for each subject makes the AI read less and lets you know where each sentence came from. Draw the tree on paper before you create it: the names come out calmly.

texto: The # at the start of a line makes a title, ## makes a subtitle, and the hyphen makes a list item. The file ends in .md and opens in any text editor.
It's still just text: whoever reads it understands the structure even without formatting.

exemplo.texto: # Feira de ciências  ## Materiais  - algodão e um copo

texto: It says what the project is for and how to check the result. Five sections: Propósito, Leia primeiro, Organização, Como verificar and Estado atual.
Don't know a field yet? Write "a definir". An honest open field is worth more than template text nobody checked.

exemplo.texto: Every registered group appears in the final list.

texto: It tells the agent who you are, the project's rules, and what's in the folder. Claude Code and Codex read the same file, so the rules apply to both.
Start with three rules of your own. In lesson 7 it grows and gets rules you can check.

exemplo.texto: Before you finish, tell me what changed and how I can check it.

texto: notepad README.md opens the file in Notepad; Ctrl+S saves it. type README.md shows in cmd what was saved.
Swapped accents in cmd, like Ã§ in place of ç, are only the screen; the file is fine.

exemplo.texto: nano README.md to edit, cat README.md to view.

secoes.titulo: The tree and the two files
secoes.sub: Create the folders in cmd and paste the templates into Notepad. Replace whatever is between < >.

blocos.conteudo:
cd %USERPROFILE%\projetos
mkdir config
cd meu-primeiro-agente
mkdir entradas
mkdir saidas
dir /b

# Meu primeiro agente

## Purpose
<what this project produces, in one sentence>

## Read first
1. AGENTS.md
2. ../config/decisoes.md
3. ../config/memoria.md

## Organization
- entradas: what the AI reads
- saidas: what it produces, for me to review

## How to check
<how someone confirms the result is right>

## Current status
To be defined.

# Who I am
<your name, your profession, who you work for>

# Rules for this project
- Write in English, short sentences.
- Work only inside this folder. Do not delete files without asking.
- Before you finish, tell me what changed and how I can check it.

# What is here
- entradas/: material you can read
- saidas/: where you deliver the drafts

notepad README.md
notepad AGENTS.md
type AGENTS.md

abas.html:
C:\Users\ana\projetos
├─ config
└─ meu-primeiro-agente
   ├─ AGENTS.md
   ├─ README.md
   ├─ entradas
   └─ saidas

Notepad asks if you want to create the new file: answer Yes. Save with Ctrl+S and close.

• The file becomes AGENTS.md.txt: in Notepad, under Save as type, choose "All files", or create it with notepad AGENTS.md in cmd.
  • Everything in the Documents folder: the agent reads tests, contracts and notes that have nothing to do with the task.
  • Same preference repeated in every project: it lives only once, in config.

secoes.sub: Create the folders and check, just like on your computer.

Saídas: what it produces, for you to review.

exercicios.titulo: E5 · The tree and the README
exercicios.texto: Draw the tree on paper, create config, entradas and saidas from the cmd, and write the README with the five sections.
exercicios.pronto: dir /b shows entradas, saidas and README.md, and each README section has real information or "to be defined".

exercicios.texto: Create AGENTS.md with who you are, the project rules and what is in the folder.
exercicios.pronto: type AGENTS.md shows at least three rules of yours, written by you.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: You want to save "I prefer short reports, with pending items at the end". Where does this note live?
opcoes: In the config folder, outside the projects.
In entradas, for the AI to read.
perguntas.explica: A preference that applies to all projects lives in config, just once. Repeating it in every project creates versions that contradict each other.

perguntas.p: What is the difference between README.md and AGENTS.md?
opcoes: The README is only for Codex.
The README is for people; AGENTS.md gives working rules to the agent.
perguntas.explica: Each one has a reader. The README explains the project to whoever arrives; AGENTS.md tells the agent how to work there.

perguntas.p: You asked for a summary of the science fair and a report card grade showed up in the middle. What is the likely cause?
opcoes: The folder mixed subjects and the report card was in it.
perguntas.explica: A folder with several subjects turns into noise. One folder per context makes the AI read only the material for the task.
